pages.title: Containment Field Glass
pages.text: Glass that is not really glass, but a field held between two panes with a shimmer of plasma in between. It holds back heat, cold and pressure that would shatter any ordinary window, and it hums faintly when touched.
$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)I needed windows that could watch a reaction without melting. I gave up on the glass and trusted the field instead, which holds the reaction and lets the light pass through.

Made in a crafting grid.$(br2)$(thing)Unlocked by$(): Precision Lithography.$(br2)$(thing)Used in$(): Abiogenesis Crucible, Anomaly Containment Ward, Bioreactor, Chemical Reactor, Chronostatic Vault, Cryogenic Cooling Jacket, Dyson Sphere Model, Empty Containment Cell and more.
